latestVersion.changelog:
js2java 1.0.0

- Initial release of the JS → Java full-stack translation assistant.
- Converts JavaScript business logic to complete, runnable Java code following Spring Boot conventions.
- Always outputs full code (DTO, Entity, Repository, Service, Controller, Exception, GlobalExceptionHandler), not just snippets.
- Every Java-specific syntax is annotated with concise, educational comments for front-end developers.
- Designed to help front-end developers learn Spring Boot and Java idioms while translating code or requirements.
